section_summary.extract_value: This section describes confirmatory factor analysis and structural equation modeling for the CEMS across Study 2 (referenced implicitly by comparison to Study 1). The analysis tested a maladaptive structural model examining relationships among restrictive/critical eating messages, familial pressure to be lean, body dissatisfaction, and disordered eating, with BMI as a covariate. Multiple-group analysis revealed no significant gender differences in structural paths between women and men (N=288).
